raw_attributes.value: FRAM Extra Guard® Oil Filters deliver advanced engine protection for everyday drivers who perform routine oil changes at OE recommended intervals. Extra Guard is engineered for extended performance that meets all manufacturers recommended change intervals. No matter what you drive, or what motor oil you  use, FRAM® has a filter for you.
